description: Which exporter sends, on which interface, and whether it is still sending.

panels.description: REAL DATA = at least one real exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = real exporters known, but no recent flows (not proof of failure). NO REAL EXPORTER DATA = nothing from a real exporter in 24 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(active > 0, 2, known > 0, 1, 0) AS s FROM (
     SELECT uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS active, uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS known
     FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

panels.title: STATUS

panels.description: Exporters that sent flows in the last 5 minutes / exporters seen in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)), ' / ', toString(uniqExact(ExporterAddress))) AS v
   FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')

panels.title: ACTIVE EXPORTERS

panels.description: Exporters seen in the last 7 days with no flows in the last 5 minutes. Idle is not proof of failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(last < now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) FROM (SELECT ExporterAddress, max(TimeReceived) AS last FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ExporterAddress)

panels.title: SILENT EXPORTERS

targets.rawSql: SELECT count()/300 FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName)

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, ExporterName AS exporter, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, exporter ORDER BY time

panels.description: Interface names come from static/SNMP metadata. "Unresolved interface" = no name known for that ifIndex.

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, concat(ExporterName, ' / ', if(InIfName = '', 'Router-local', InIfName)) AS interface, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, interface ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traffic by ingress interface

panels.description: Role comes from verified interface boundary metadata. Router-local = traffic to/from the router itself (no output interface). Inbound/Outbound apply to external interfaces; Ingress/Egress to other interfaces. Utilization % is intentionally not shown: interface speed is not verified.

defaults.noValue: No recent flows on any interface for the selected scope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(flows/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR))), 3) AS `Flows/s`, dateDiff('second', lastts, now()) AS `Last flow` FROM (
       SELECT ExporterName AS Exporter, multiIf(InIfName = '', 'Router-local', InIfName = 'ifindex-unmapped', 'Unresolved interface', InIfName) AS Interface, multiIf(InIfName = '', 'Router', InIfBoundary = 'external', 'External', InIfBoundary = 'internal', 'Internal', 'Unclassified') AS Role, if(InIfBoundary = 'external', 'Inbound', 'Ingress') AS Direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes, count() AS flows, max(TimeReceived) AS lastts
          FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND (InIfName = '' OR has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName)) GROUP BY Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction UNION ALL SELECT ExporterName AS Exporter, multiIf(OutIfName = '', 'Router-local', OutIfName = 'ifindex-unmapped', 'Unresolved interface', OutIfName) AS Interface, multiIf(OutIfName = '', 'Router', OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'External', OutIfBoundary = 'internal', 'Internal', 'Unclassified') AS Role, if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'Outbound', 'Egress') AS Direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes, count() AS flows, max(TimeReceived) AS lastts
          FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND (OutIfName = '' OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) GROUP BY Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction) ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Interfaces (last ≤24 h)

panels.description: ACTIVE: flows in the last 5 min. IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS: seen in the last 7 days but quiet — this is not proof of failure (NetFlow alone cannot prove a router is down). Traffic and flows/s are 5-minute averages.

defaults.noValue: No exporter has sent flows in the last 7 days (for the selected data scope)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.exporter AS Exporter,
          multiIf(isNull(r.age), 'UNKNOWN', ifNull(x.age, r.age) <= 300, 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
          ifNull(x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, ifNull(x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, ifNull(x.age, r.age) AS `Last flow`
   FROM (SELECT ExporterName AS exporter, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s
         WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY exporter) AS r
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS exporter, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age
              FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY exporter) AS x ON r.exporter = x.exporter
   ORDER BY `Last flow`
